newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid completes sale of Bi-Mart.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid completes sale of Bi-Mart.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp said Tuesday it had completed the sale of Bi-Mart Membership Discount Stores to a corporation formed and owned by Bi-Mart's senior executives and Endeavour Capital of Portland, Ore.

Bi-Mart operates 46 stores in 35 communities in Oregon and Washington and has annual sales of nearly $400 million. The chain offers housewares, pharmacy products, photoelectronics, clothing, automotive goods, hardware, food and snacks, toys, sporting goods and other items.

Marty Smith, chief executive officer of Bi-Mart Acquisition Corp, said from Eugene, Ore., that no changes are expected for Bi-Mart's 2,500 employees, including 300 who will work at the company's executive offices and distribution center in Eugene.
He said Bi-Mart plans to open four new stores sometime later this year or early next year in Eugene, Coravalis, Sutherlin and Portland.
